subject: Activation roadmap — streaming + toolcalls + schema alignment
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@medicore.com>, Marc Duval <marc.duval@medicore.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Activation roadmap — streaming + toolcalls + schema alignment

Hi Elena / Marc,

Following our trial / evaluation wrap-up, this thread kicks off the feature activation plan for real-time streaming, function/tool calling, and structured JSON outputs. Attached are a one-page activation checklist and an example output schema to ground the workshop.

High-level proposed runway (three-week baseline):
- Week 0 (this week): alignment call + schema workshop (60–90m) — define required fields, error paths, and toolcall contracts.
- Week 1: integration sprint — test harness + prefix/KV caching config.
- Week 2: validation & QA — load tests, quantization profile checks, rollout gating.

Immediate asks:
1) Confirm which of the two workshop slots works for your team: Thu Jun 14 10:00am PT or Thu Jun 14 2:00pm PT.
2) Share a sample of the payloads you plan to send (PII redacted) or a short description of expected tokens per request — helps us size batching and latency SLOs.

I’ve looped in Monica to coordinate the checklist and Laura for delivery sequencing. Rishi will join the security call if your security / privacy folks want to go deeper.

Attachments: activation_checklist.xlsx, example_output_schema.json, sequence_diagram.png

Thanks — looking forward to enabling this cleanly.

—
Vivek Kulkarni
Implementation Lead, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182

From: Elena Rossi <elena@medicore.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marc Duval <marc.duval@medicore.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Activation roadmap — streaming + toolcalls + schema alignment

Thanks, Vivek — this looks good and concrete. A couple of clarifications from our side:

- Payloads: we can share a representative sample (anonymized) by EOD Wednesday. Most requests are ~400–700 tokens; occasional long notes hit ~2,000.
- Tool calling: when you say "toolcall contracts," do we need to define an OpenAPI-like spec or is a lightweight JSON schema sufficient for first pass?
- Security: our privacy lead (copied here) may request details on data retention and KV caching behavior — I’ve attached the list of initial questions.

Workshop: Thu Jun 14 2:00pm PT works best for our engineering and product teams.

Also: do you expect any changes to the client-side SDK or will this be transparent over existing API calls?

Appreciate the clarity — looking forward to the workshop.

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 11:25:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Activation roadmap — streaming + toolcalls + schema alignment

Folks — forwarding Medicore reply. Action items I want to split: 

- Monica: lead the schema workshop and prepare a short "schema decision" template we can use in the meeting (fields, validation rules, failure semantics). Add the example_output_schema.json as a baseline.
- Rishi: review the privacy_questions.pdf and prepare a concise answer doc on retention, KV caching, and what we log for debugging (we should include our default TTLs and an opt-out path).
- Laura: run the calendar invite and prepare the test-harness repo link; ensure the sequence_diagram.png is in the Drive folder.

Keep the response short — I’ll send the tentative invite for Thu 2pm PT once you confirm availability.

> > Thanks, Vivek — this looks good and concrete. A couple of clarifications from our side...

—
Vivek

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Activation roadmap — streaming + toolcalls + schema alignment

Elena / Marc,

Thanks — confirmed for Thu Jun 14 at 2:00pm PT. I’ll run the 75-minute workshop with the following agenda:

1) Introductions & success criteria (10m)
2) JSON schema walkthrough for streaming outputs (25m) — we’ll agree on required fields and error models.
3) Toolcall contract patterns (15m) — expected inputs, allowed side effects, and retry semantics.
4) Integration checklist & test-harness instructions (15m)
5) Next steps & owners (10m)

Rishi will cover the privacy/retention items in a short (10m) segment inside #3. We’ll upload the meeting artifacts to the Drive folder here: https://drive.redwood.ai/handbooks/MDCR-activation/overview

Elena — if you can drop the anonymized payloads into that folder before the meeting, that will speed gating.

See you Thursday — Monica

—
